adjusting or altering clothes to fit better

notes:
WASEI-EIGO:
リフォーム is Japanese-made English. In standard English, 'reform' doesn't typically mean renovation. The English equivalents would be 'renovation' or 'remodeling.'

HOME RENOVATION:

- リフォーム⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ - renovation costs
- ⟦{水回|みずまわ}り→水回り：08063_mizumawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧リフォーム - plumbing area renovation
- ⟦{内装|ないそう}→内装：06425_naisou⟧リフォーム - interior renovation
- ⟦{外壁|がいへき}→外壁：06426_gaiheki⟧リフォーム - exterior renovation
